data.exact_reserve_text: The change in claims outstanding includes the impact of strengthening of net reserves for claims incurred on the prior years of GBP 7,637k (2022: release of GBP 87k). These net reserve movements are stated net of the protection provided by the LPT.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Provided $450m adverse development cover on Group reserves at the effective date; had a favourable impact on the prior year underwriting loss of GBP 9.3m in the current year (2023).

Exposures reviewed (aviation reinsurance, credit and political risks and international crisis management); reasonable provision made for identified potential claims; not expected to be material for the Syndicate.

named_events.loss_description: Continued activity in Russia and Ukraine; exposures reviewed and potential claims identified; reasonable provision made; not expected to be material.
Ongoing conflict referenced; exposures are being assessed but not expected to be material for the Syndicate.
LPT covers 2019 and prior accident years and provides adverse development cover; favourable impact on prior year underwriting loss of GBP 9.3m in 2023.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims reserves were GBP 1,267.1m. Using the gross claims development table the Syndicate recorded a net prior-year gross strengthening of approximately GBP 77.1m (6.1% of opening gross reserves), driven by adverse development in older underwriting years (notably 2018-2020) and inflationary/claims cost pressures. This adverse development was partially offset by the Loss Portfolio Transfer with Enstar which produced a favourable impact of GBP 9.3m on prior-year underwriting results. Exposures related to geopolitical events (Russia/Ukraine and Israel/Gaza) were reviewed and provisioned where appropriate but were not expected to be material to the Syndicate.
raw_causal_phrases: strengthening of net reserves for claims incurred on the prior years of GBP 7,637k (2022: release of GBP 87k).
The Management Best Estimate includes an explicit uplift in respect of the potential impact of higher inflation on loss costs.
The LPT provides the Aspen Group with $450m adverse development cover on Group reserves of $3.12bn at the effective date.
Exposures relating to the Russia and Ukraine conflict have been reviewed and Aspen has identified impacted policy holders and potential claims, and examined received claims.
We have assessed the impacts of both economic and social inflation on the reserve adequacy of the Syndicate's liabilities.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross reserves taken from Balance Sheet (liabilities) prior-year comparative column. No explicit gross prior-year movement figure provided in narrative; prior-year gross movement was calculated from the published gross claims development triangle (page 37). The report explicitly discloses a net prior-year strengthening of GBP 7.637k (net of LPT and reinsurances) which differs from the gross triangle-derived figure; LPT and reinsurance recoveries materially affect the net-versus-gross amounts.
